text:
ana: FYI ResellPro sent their May marketplace invoice v2 (RP-330). Their metered units jump 2.8x vs our metering. Attached CSV shows the mismatch. Can ops confirm whether this is a partner-side duplicate or our ingest?

rachel: I checked our token-counter service and ingestion pipeline. No anomalous spikes in our production metrics for May 2026 (per-host CPU, request counts all flat). Snapshot: resellpro_reported=420k, our_reconciled=150k.

tom: Partner-ops pinged ResellPro. They say they ran a backfill script on May 31 that reprocessed a month of events and accidentally re-ingested already-billed usage. They admitted missing an idempotency key for the batch job.

ana: (typo) ana: noted. Do they propose a credit memo or revised invoice?

partner-ops: ResellPro confirms they will send corrected invoice + credit memo within 7 business days. They'll provide the corrected CSV and a short root-cause note.

ana: Given month close is tomorrow, we need to decide whether to post an adjustment. Tom/rachel thoughts on provisional accounting?

tom: Recommend posting a provisional contra-revenue for the overstated amount so our revenue doesn't include the duplication. Use GL 4-125 "Marketplace Partner Corrections" and memo: "Provisional adjustment pending ResellPro CM RP-330-revise". Estimated amount $27,300.

rachel: Agree. Also add a note in the month-end pack about contingent liability until CM is received.

billing-bot: Provisional JV created: JV-2026-0512, amount $27,300, GL 4-125, status=PENDING_REVERSAL, ticket FIN-4598.

ana: Ana (Finance) to prepare partner-facing email, include JV ref. ResellPro asked we don't escalate publicly.

partner-ops: We'll follow up with ResellPro to push the CM timeline. Also asked them to include the failed job id and the missing idempotency key in their RCA.

tom: One ops action: add a reconciliation check that flags >1.5x month-over-month for reseller reports before ingesting. I'll open an infra PR.

billing-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-7723 (add reseller duplicate-prevent check). Assigned tom.

rachel: Adding this thread to month-close folder. Leave open until CM posted.

ana: Draft email template for record:

"Subject: ResellPro RP-330 - provisional adjustment posted"

"Hi <ResellPro contact>,

Thanks for the update and proposed fix. We have posted a provisional accounting adjustment (JV-2026-0512) for the overstated May usage pending your revised invoice and credit memo. Please send the corrected invoice and CM referencing RP-330 to billing@redwood.ai. Once received we'll reverse the provisional JV and reconcile.

Best,
Ana (Finance)"

rachel: Thx. Closing loop once CM attached to FIN-4598.
